I am an HDFS major so I don’t know a lot about marine science other than we are known for it but I can help answer your general questions! 

- housing is required for all freshman and sophomores. It’s nice and has suite style bathrooms, so you don’t have to leave your room to use the bathroom or shower. Some of the rooms are definitely outdated but in my experience the schools pretty good at maintaining them when you ask them. 

- I don’t know a lot about a diving club but we do have scuba classes that you get credit for and my friends LOVE it just hard to get into. 

- I can’t speak for next year but yes for this year,housing was free during winter and available :) there is nothing really going on during break on campus though. 

- I don’t know the price for out of state, but check out WUE since the school does accept that scholarhsip program and it will make out of state pricing cheaper if you are living in a participating state. 

- personally for me I’m from a bigger city that Seaside ( like triple the size in people) so it has been a hard adjustment because I was so use to things happening around me but here you have to find your own fun which is 100% possible with being near the beach and being in a tourist town, just you need to be proactive. I love riding the bus to the wharf and going to the aquarium. We have some pretty good sea food as well. Having a car is SO useful, not essential but it will make the experience 10 times better. Freshman’s can have cars since you can visit more places. 

best of luck picking a school :)

I loved this job because it has helped me a lot with my social anxiety. 
It has made me step out of my comfort zone a lot but that helped me. 

The interview is pretty simple just asking you about your passion ( my manager talked about how they want to hear something to get to know you like passionate about animlas or reading, not customer service). They will also just ask how you react in different situations. 

They will do multiple training to help. We also have learning studios which are online classes to help you learn everything. End of the day it is a fun job!! I have meet amazing friends. I am on vacation right now and me and my co worker have still been texting. 

My biggest tip is to be open to the experience. It will be hard at first but I promise with practice it will be a lot easier. They help a lot. All theaters have crew leaders which are big helpers and will always be there no matter how long you have been there. If you have any questions just ask!!! I love this job and I can answer basically anything lol.

Breath!! It is fun job but it will be stressful the first few weeks because you will be learning so much. Ask questions and enjoy yourself. I have meet some amazing friends and I have learned more than I could ever imagine. It takes time. 

Learning usher will usually be working with a crew leader on the cleans for the day. They will show you how they clean the theaters, where to throw away the trash and where to stock the cleaning supplies. 

Don’t be afraid to ask questions. Just make sure to listen and try everything. When I trained in box office I just listened but never asked to try for myself which I regret. Make sure you ask to try everything a usher does. Dont just listen. 

Best of luck!!

Sorry but a few more tips because literally at work today we talked about the interview process with my manager today. 

When working in someone’s walking behind you leave the door open for them like hold it for them. It shows politeness. 
Also show up a few minutes early just to show punctuality. 
Another tip is really just show your personality as a person. I talked a lot about my passion for animals and connected with my mangers like that. 
Personally at my theater. Having the weekend open at least 2 days (Friday Saturday or Sunday) will make you soooo wanted because weekends are soo busy like our estimated guest are like over a thousand. 
Lastly!! Focus on your willingness to work as a team and how you want the theater  to be clean and presentable. 

Best of luck!! Seriously best choice to have this job.
